title: Cell Free Preimplantation Genetic Testing
official: Evaluation of Cell Free Preimplantation Genetic Testing
summary: This study aims to develop preimplantation genetic testing methods from embryo culture media (cell free). Genetic testing of culture media will be compared to conventional methods based on embryo biopsies.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing IVF electing to utilize LifeView testing (PGT) will be offered participation in this study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
